title: Norfolk Southern opens Indiana Flood Disaster Relief Grant Program
body_markdown:
In response to the historic flooding impacting communities across central, eastern and southern Indiana, Norfolk Southern has opened its[Community Disaster Relief Grant Program](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/commitments/in-your-community/community-impact/grant-programs) to support local recovery efforts.


Nonprofit organizations assisting individuals, families and communities affected by the flooding are encouraged to apply for funding by sharing how they are supporting response and recovery efforts. **Eligible organizations may submit applications until September 30 through the program's online portal**[here.](https://www.cybergrants.com/pls/cybergrants/ao_login.login?x_gm_id=10212&x_proposal_type_id=104390) **(** Note: new users will need to create an account and submit their request.)


"Strong communities are the foundation of our railroad, and we're committed to standing alongside our neighbors during times of need," said Kristin Wong, Director of Norfolk Southern Foundation & Community Impact. "As communities across Indiana begin the long process of recovery, we hope these grants can help local organizations deliver critical support where it is needed most."


With a significant presence in Indiana, including thousands of employees, extensive rail operations and long-standing partnerships across the state, Norfolk Southern is committed to helping communities recover and rebuild following natural disasters.


Norfolk Southern's Community Disaster Relief Grant Program provides financial support to local nonprofit organizations delivering immediate assistance and long-term recovery services in areas impacted by disasters across the company's network.


Organizations with questions about the program may contact **NSCommunityImpact@nscorp.com** .


**About Norfolk Southern Community Impact**


Norfolk Southern believes that investing in the well-being of the communities it serves is essential to building a stronger future. Through strategic philanthropy, volunteerism, and partnerships, the company supports initiatives focused on safety, sustainability, workforce development, and community resilience.
